limitations: Historical synthetic/model calibration only; no new scientific adjudication or nature-level inference.

legacy.claim: The operational max_stars=8000 brightness cap is not itself the source of any geometry-coupled v-tilde(g_N) bias: the uncapped (R1-uncapped) and heavily-capped (R1-heavycap, max_stars=2000) arms of the same nonuniform-footprint population agree with the baseline-cap arm (R1-baseline) within the seed-to-seed bootstrap uncertainty in every populated bin.
legacy.kill: R1-uncapped or R1-heavycap median B_i differs from R1-baseline by more than the combined seed-to-seed uncertainty in any populated bin.
legacy.evidence: ORB-11222's cataloged frozen run at Orrery 28dd5c72 finds a heavy-cap deviation beyond combined uncertainty, but failed R0 prevents isolation of an apparatus effect. The unresolved result is retained without retuning; ORB-11241 owns diagnosis.
